# LCARS — API reference (v1.0.0)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.mjs — edit src/meta/api.mjs, src/css/*.css or src/recipes/ instead. -->

LCARS is a framework-agnostic CSS design system for building Star Trek LCARS-style interfaces. It is plain HTML classes + CSS custom properties (all inside `@layer lcars.*`), plus an optional dependency-free ES module (`lcars.js`) for clocks, animated data, theme switching and sounds. It works with any stack that outputs HTML (static, React, Vue, Svelte, server templates).

Read **Rules** and **Common mistakes** first; copy structure from **Recipes** (docs/recipes.md).

## Setup

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" class="lcars" data-lcars-theme="tng">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/janos97/lcars@master/dist/lcars.min.css">
  <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/janos97/lcars@master/dist/lcars.js"></script> <!-- optional -->
</head>
<body>
  <!-- see recipe "app-shell" -->
</body>
</html>
```

npm: `npm install github:janos97/lcars`, then `import "lcars/lcars.css"` and optionally `import "lcars/lcars.js"`.
Files: `dist/lcars.css` (readable), `dist/lcars.min.css`, `dist/lcars.js` (ES module), `dist/fonts/` (keep next to the CSS), `dist/lcars.manifest.json` (this API as JSON).

## Rules

1. Load `lcars.css`; optionally load `lcars.js` with `<script type="module">`. Put `class="lcars"` on `<html>` (or on the wrapper of the LCARS part of a page).
2. Build pages as `.lcars-app` > one or more `.lcars-frame`. The standard page is a header frame (bottom elbow) followed by a body frame (top elbow) whose `__side` holds navigation and whose `__main` holds content.
3. Frame parts (`__elbow-top`, `__bar-top`, `__side`, `__main`, `__elbow-bottom`, `__bar-bottom`) must be direct children of `.lcars-frame`. Omit the parts you don't need; never wrap them.
4. Finish every `__side` with a filler `<div class="lcars-block lcars-grow"></div>` (or put it between items) so the sidebar reaches the elbow.
5. Bars contain empty `<span class="lcars-block"></span>` segments (weight with `.lcars-grow-N`), optionally a `.lcars-bar__title`, and usually a `.lcars-round-end` cap on the last segment.
6. Color pieces with classes, never with `background-color`. Use role classes (`lcars-c-primary|secondary|tertiary|accent|muted|alert`) so themes work; use swatch classes (`lcars-c-orange`, …) only for colors that must not change with the theme, and `lcars-c-green` / `lcars-c-alert` for status meaning. For a one-off color set `style="--lcars-c: #hex"`.
7. Navigation = `<a class="lcars-block">` inside `__side`, current page marked `aria-current="page"`. Actions = `<button class="lcars-button">` in content, or `<button class="lcars-block">` inside sidebars. Toggles use `aria-pressed`, tabs use `role="tab"` + `aria-selected`.
8. Group content in `.lcars-bracket` cards laid out with `.lcars-grid`; use a `.lcars-bar` with a `.lcars-bar__title` as a section heading.
9. Forms: `<label class="lcars-field"><span class="lcars-label">Name</span><input class="lcars-input"></label>`. Show errors with `aria-invalid="true"` plus a `.lcars-hint`.
10. Write labels in normal case; CSS uppercases headings and controls. Keep labels short (1–2 words). Decorative numeric codes such as `04-2291` in elbows/blocks are optional flavor.
11. Customize by overriding tokens (`--lcars-side`, `--lcars-bar`, `--lcars-gap`, roles, …) on `:root` or an element. Your own unlayered CSS always beats the framework; never use `!important`.
12. Pick a series look with `data-lcars-theme` on `<html>` (or any element for a scoped look). Theme ids: tng (default), tos, snw, dis, ent, ds9, voy, nemesis, ld, pro, pic, red-alert.
13. Animate only with `.lcars-pulse` / `.lcars-blink` or `data-lcars-cascade`; they switch off automatically for reduced-motion users.
14. `lcars.js` is optional and attribute-driven; it must be served over http(s), auto-upgrades elements added later (SPA-safe) and is safe to import during SSR.

## Common mistakes

| Don't | Do |
| --- | --- |
| Wrapping frame parts in extra `<div>`s or placing them outside `.lcars-frame` | Make every `lcars-frame__*` element a direct child of its `.lcars-frame`. |
| `style="background: #f90"` on a block, button or elbow | `class="lcars-c-primary"`, or `style="--lcars-c: #f90"`. |
| Only swatch classes (`lcars-c-orange`) everywhere, so theme switching changes nothing | Use role classes (`lcars-c-primary`, `-secondary`, `-tertiary`, `-accent`) for chrome. |
| Sidebar stops short of the bottom elbow | Add `<div class="lcars-block lcars-grow"></div>` to `__side`. |
| `.lcars-button` pills stacked in a sidebar | Sidebar items are rectangles: use `.lcars-block` (as `<a>` or `<button>`). |
| Paragraphs, inputs or large text inside a bar | Bars are one `--lcars-bar` tall: put only segments and one short `.lcars-bar__title` in them. |
| `<div class="lcars-block" onclick=…>` for actions | Use `<button class="lcars-block">` or `<a class="lcars-block" href>` so it is focusable and gets hover/active states. |
| Meter width set in percent (`style="width: 70%"`) | `style="--lcars-value: .7"` (0–1) or `aria-valuenow` with `lcars.js`. |
| Hand-written CSS for gaps, radii or fonts | Override the matching token (`--lcars-gap`, `--lcars-inner-radius`, `--lcars-font`). |
| Nesting one `.lcars-app` inside another | Use a single `.lcars-app` per page; nest `.lcars-frame`s inside `__main` instead. |
| A wide `.lcars-table` straight in the page (overflows phones) | Wrap it: `<div class="lcars-scroll" tabindex="0" aria-label="…">`. |
| Opening a page that loads `lcars.js` from `file://` | Serve it over http (`npm run dev`, any static server). |

## Which component do I need?

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| A full-page app layout | `.lcars-app` with a header frame and a body frame (recipe: app-shell) |
| LCARS chrome on top of an existing app | A single header `.lcars-frame` (recipe: header-only) |
| Primary navigation | `<a class="lcars-block">` items in `.lcars-frame__side` (recipe: sidebar-nav) |
| A card / panel | `.lcars-bracket`, or a nested `.lcars-frame` with both elbows for a heavier panel |
| KPIs / stats | `.lcars-bracket` + `.lcars-readout` and `.lcars-meter` (recipe: dashboard-tiles) |
| A section heading | `.lcars-bar` containing a `.lcars-bar__title` (recipe: section-heading) |
| Tabs or a segmented control | `.lcars-cluster` of `.lcars-button--sm` with `role="tab"`/`aria-selected` (recipe: tabs) |
| A modal | `<dialog class="lcars-dialog">` wrapping a bracket or frame (recipe: dialog) |
| Custom shapes or a widget (e.g. the circular X/Y control) | Inline `<svg class="lcars-svg">` with `.lcars-c-*` on shapes and `role="button"` on clickable ones (recipe: svg-control) |
| Console sounds | `data-lcars-sound` on a container; `LCARS.beep("alert")`; your own files via `LCARS.setSounds({...})` |
| Tabular data | `.lcars-table` with `.lcars-num` numeric cells and `.lcars-pill` statuses (recipe: data-table) |
| A form | `.lcars-field` + `.lcars-input` / `.lcars-check` / `.lcars-switch` / `.lcars-range` (recipe: form) |
| Status tag | `.lcars-pill` with `lcars-c-green` / `lcars-c-alert` / `lcars-c-muted` |
| Decorative number field | `<div class="lcars-data" data-lcars-cascade="48"></div>` |
| Live clock or stardate | `<span data-lcars-clock></span>`, `<span data-lcars-stardate></span>` |

## Color model

Every colored piece (block, button, elbow, bar segment, bracket, meter, pill, table, input) paints itself with `var(--lcars-c)` and sets a default for it. Change the color with a class:

- `lcars-c-{role}` — primary, secondary, tertiary, accent, muted, alert, active. **Themeable: prefer these.**
- `lcars-c-{swatch}` — orange, gold, butterscotch, peach, sunflower, violet, lilac, pink, magenta, blue, sky, ice, moonlight, green, red, mars, tomato, gray, white. Fixed colors (only red-alert remaps them).
- `style="--lcars-c: #hex"` — one-off color.
- `lcars-text-{role|swatch|fg}` sets `color` instead.

Text on colored pieces uses `--lcars-on-c` (black). State attributes (`aria-current`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-invalid`, …) override color classes.

## Components

### Page scope — `lcars`

Opt-in page styles: black background, LCARS font, text color, heading/link/code styles. Components work without it.

**Use on:** <html> (whole page) or any wrapper element

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars` | Applies page-level LCARS typography and background to this element and its descendants. |

```html
<html lang="en" class="lcars">
```

### App shell — `lcars-app`

Full-viewport vertical stack of frames; the last child grows to fill the screen.

**Use on:** <div>

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-app` | Full-height column with gaps between frames. One per page. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-app-padding` | Outer padding (default clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem)). |

```html
<div class="lcars-app">
  <header class="lcars-frame">…</header>
  <div class="lcars-frame">…</div>
</div>
```

### Frame — `lcars-frame`

The sidebar + elbow + bar construction that defines LCARS. A 2-column grid; every part is optional. Header frame = bottom parts only; body frame = top parts only; panel = both.

**Use on:** <section>, <header>, <div> · **Default color:** primary (elbows inherit the frame's --lcars-c)

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-frame` | Grid container. Its --lcars-c colors both elbows unless an elbow has its own color class. |
| `lcars-frame--right` | Mirror: sidebar and elbows on the right. |
| `lcars-frame__elbow-top` | Top corner piece (outer curve top-left) with arm and inner fillet drawn automatically. Optional short label sits bottom-right. May be <div>, <a> or <button>. |
| `lcars-frame__elbow-bottom` | Bottom corner piece (outer curve bottom-left). Optional label sits top-right. |
| `lcars-frame__bar-top` | Bar next to the top elbow; behaves like .lcars-bar. |
| `lcars-frame__bar-bottom` | Bar next to the bottom elbow; behaves like .lcars-bar. |
| `lcars-frame__side` | Vertical stack of .lcars-block items between the elbows. Add a .lcars-grow block as filler. |
| `lcars-frame__main` | Content area beside the sidebar. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-side` | Sidebar width. |
| `--lcars-bar` | Bar thickness. |
| `--lcars-elbow-height` | Minimum elbow height. |
| `--lcars-elbow-reach` | Length of the elbow arm past the sidebar. |
| `--lcars-elbow-rx` | Horizontal radius of the outer curve. |
| `--lcars-inner-radius` | Radius of the inner fillet. |
| `--lcars-frame-pad` | Padding of __main (default 1rem). |

**Accessibility:** Use landmark elements: <header> for a header frame, <nav aria-label> for __side navigation, <main> for the page's primary __main.

```html
<div class="lcars-frame">
  <div class="lcars-frame__elbow-top">02-4471</div>
  <div class="lcars-frame__bar-top">
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-3"></span>
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary lcars-round-end"></span>
  </div>
  <nav class="lcars-frame__side" aria-label="Main">
    <a class="lcars-block lcars-c-accent" href="/" aria-current="page">Home</a>
    <a class="lcars-block lcars-c-tertiary" href="/logs">Logs</a>
    <div class="lcars-block lcars-grow"></div>
  </nav>
  <main class="lcars-frame__main">…</main>
</div>
```

### Block — `lcars-block`

The basic colored rectangle with its label in the bottom-right corner. Sidebar items, bar segments, swatches, big square buttons.

**Use on:** <div>/<span> (decorative), <a href> (navigation), <button> (action) · **Default color:** primary

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-block` | Solid colored slab; label bottom-right; hover/active/focus states when it is an <a>, <button> or <label>. |
| `lcars-block--short` | 60% of the normal block height. |
| `lcars-block--tall` | Twice the normal block height. |
| `lcars-block--top` | Label at the top instead of the bottom. |
| `lcars-block--start` | Label at the start (left) instead of the end. |
| `lcars-block--center` | Label centered. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-block-height` | Minimum height (default 3.5rem). |

**States:** aria-current / aria-pressed="true" / aria-selected="true" / .is-active → active color; disabled / aria-disabled="true" → dimmed.

```html
<a class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary" href="/sensors">Sensors</a>
<button class="lcars-block lcars-block--tall lcars-c-alert">Red alert</button>
```

### Button — `lcars-button`

Pill-shaped control for actions in content areas. Label bottom-right.

**Use on:** <button>, <a href> · **Default color:** primary

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-button` | Pill button. |
| `lcars-button--sm` | Small (2rem tall). |
| `lcars-button--lg` | Large (3.75rem tall). |
| `lcars-button--block` | Full width. |
| `lcars-button--center` | Centered label. |
| `lcars-addon` | Black number plate inside a button or block, colored with the parent's --lcars-c. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-control` | Height. |
| `--lcars-button-width` | Minimum width (default 7.5rem). |

**States:** Same as Block. Shape with .lcars-round-start / .lcars-round-end / .lcars-square.

```html
<button class="lcars-button">Engage</button>
<button class="lcars-button lcars-c-secondary lcars-round-end">Scan</button>
<button class="lcars-button lcars-c-accent">Warp <span class="lcars-addon">9</span></button>
```

### Bar — `lcars-bar`

Horizontal strip of segments separated by thin gaps. Segments share width equally unless weighted.

**Use on:** <div>

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-bar` | Flex row, one --lcars-bar tall. |
| `lcars-bar--thin` | 0.6rem tall. |
| `lcars-bar--thick` | 2.5rem tall. |
| `lcars-bar__title` | Heading text sitting in the bar on the background color (use on h1–h6 or span). Does not stretch. |
| `lcars-bar__fixed` | Stops a segment from stretching; give it a width. |

```html
<div class="lcars-bar">
  <span class="lcars-block lcars-round-start lcars-bar__fixed" style="width: 3rem"></span>
  <h2 class="lcars-bar__title">Engineering</h2>
  <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-4"></span>
  <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary lcars-round-end"></span>
</div>
```

### Bracket — `lcars-bracket`

Content between rounded [ ] brackets — the LCARS card/panel.

**Use on:** <section>, <article>, <div>, <form> · **Default color:** secondary

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-bracket` | Card with brackets on both sides. |
| `lcars-bracket--start` | Bracket on the start side only. |
| `lcars-bracket--end` | Bracket on the end side only. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-bracket-width` | Bracket thickness (default 0.75rem). |
| `--lcars-bracket-arm` | Bracket arm length (default 2rem). |

```html
<section class="lcars-bracket lcars-c-tertiary">
  <span class="lcars-label">Sector</span>
  <h3>Alpha quadrant</h3>
  <p>No anomalies detected.</p>
</section>
```

### Typography — `lcars-title`

Text components that work anywhere (headings, links and code are also styled automatically inside .lcars).

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-title` | Display heading, right-aligned, heading color. |
| `lcars-label` | Small uppercase caption in the accent color. |
| `lcars-pill` | Small rounded status tag (tertiary by default). |
| `lcars-pill--outline` | Outlined pill. |
| `lcars-list` | List with block-shaped bullets; color items with .lcars-c-*. |

```html
<h1 class="lcars-title">Main engineering</h1>
<span class="lcars-label">Status</span>
<span class="lcars-pill lcars-c-green">Nominal</span>
<ul class="lcars-list"><li>Warp core</li><li class="lcars-c-secondary">Impulse</li></ul>
```

### Meter — `lcars-meter`

Segmented level bar driven by --lcars-value (0–1). With lcars.js, aria-valuenow/min/max drive it automatically.

**Use on:** <div role="meter"> · **Default color:** tertiary

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-meter` | Horizontal segmented meter. |
| `lcars-meter--solid` | No segment gaps. |
| `lcars-meter--round` | Rounded ends. |
| `lcars-meter--vertical` | Vertical; give the parent a height. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-value` | Fill level 0–1. |
| `--lcars-meter-height` | Thickness (default 1rem). |
| `--lcars-meter-segment` | Segment pitch (default 0.6rem). |

**Accessibility:** Add role="meter", aria-label and aria-valuenow/min/max.

```html
<div class="lcars-meter" role="meter" aria-label="Shields"
     aria-valuenow="82" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" style="--lcars-value: .82"></div>
```

### Data — `lcars-data`

Numeric displays: the dense decorative number field and a key/value readout.

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-data` | Grid of numbers in mixed palette colors. Fill it yourself or add data-lcars-cascade="N" (lcars.js) to generate and animate N cells. |
| `lcars-readout` | <dl> of key (accent) / value (right-aligned) pairs. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-data-cols` | Number of columns (default 8). |

**Accessibility:** lcars.js marks cascades aria-hidden; don't put real data in a cascade.

```html
<div class="lcars-data" data-lcars-cascade="48" style="--lcars-data-cols: 6"></div>
<dl class="lcars-readout"><dt>Warp factor</dt><dd>9.2</dd><dt>Heading</dt><dd>127 mark 4</dd></dl>
```

### Table — `lcars-table`

Data table with colored header rule, row caps and hover highlight.

**Use on:** <table> · **Default color:** tertiary

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-table` | Styled table; add .lcars-num to numeric <th>/<td> for right alignment. |

**Accessibility:** Wrap tables that can be wider than a phone in <div class="lcars-scroll" tabindex="0" aria-label="…">.

```html
<table class="lcars-table">
  <thead><tr><th>Officer</th><th class="lcars-num">Shift</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><td>Commander</td><td class="lcars-num">0800</td></tr></tbody>
</table>
```

### Forms — `lcars-field`

Restyled native controls. aria-invalid="true" switches a control to the alert color.

**Default color:** tertiary

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-field` | Stack of label, control and hint. Use on <label> (or a <div> with a proper <label for>). |
| `lcars-hint` | Small muted helper / error text under a control. |
| `lcars-input` | <input>, <select> or <textarea>. |
| `lcars-check` | Checkbox or radio (<input type="checkbox\|radio">). |
| `lcars-switch` | Checkbox rendered as a toggle switch. |
| `lcars-range` | <input type="range">. |
| `lcars-choice` | <label> wrapping a check/switch and its text. |

```html
<label class="lcars-field">
  <span class="lcars-label">Destination</span>
  <input class="lcars-input" name="dest" placeholder="Sector 001">
</label>
<label class="lcars-choice"><input class="lcars-switch" type="checkbox" checked> Autopilot</label>
```

### Dialog — `lcars-dialog`

Styles a native <dialog> as an LCARS modal. Open with dialog.showModal(); close with <form method="dialog">.

**Use on:** <dialog>

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-dialog` | Black modal surface with dark backdrop; put a bracket or frame inside. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-dialog-width` | Maximum width (default 40rem). |

```html
<dialog class="lcars-dialog" id="confirm">
  <form method="dialog" class="lcars-bracket lcars-c-alert">
    <h3>Confirm self-destruct</h3>
    <button class="lcars-button lcars-c-alert" value="yes">Confirm</button>
  </form>
</dialog>
```

### SVG — `lcars-svg`

Inline SVG that follows LCARS colors, themes and states — for shapes CSS boxes can't draw, such as the circular X/Y control. Shapes without a fill attribute are painted with --lcars-c.

**Use on:** <svg> (inline, not <img>) · **Default color:** primary

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-svg` | On the <svg>. Paints path/rect/circle/ellipse/polygon/polyline with --lcars-c (so .lcars-c-* works on shapes) and styles shapes with role="button" as controls. |

**States:** role="button" shapes: hover/active brightness, focus ring (stroke), aria-pressed/aria-selected/aria-current → active color, aria-disabled="true" → dimmed.

**Accessibility:** Give the <svg> role="group" and an aria-label; give each clickable shape role="button", tabindex="0" and an aria-label. lcars.js makes Enter/Space click them.

```html
<svg class="lcars-svg" viewBox="0 0 80 80" width="160" role="group" aria-label="Scanner">
  <path class="lcars-c-accent" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Up" d="m34 10h12v-9.5c-3.9-.5-8-.5-12 0z"/>
  <path class="lcars-c-tertiary" d="m11 34v12h23v23h12v-23h23v-12h-23v-23h-12v23z"/>
</svg>
```

### Layout helpers — `lcars-stack`

Small layout primitives. All use --lcars-space for spacing.

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-stack` | Vertical flex stack with --lcars-space gaps. |
| `lcars-cluster` | Wrapping horizontal row (button groups, tags). |
| `lcars-split` | Row with items pushed to both ends. |
| `lcars-grid` | Responsive auto-fit grid; min column width --lcars-grid-min. |
| `lcars-span-all` | Grid child spanning every column. |

| Custom property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--lcars-space` | Gap size. |
| `--lcars-grid-min` | Minimum grid column width (default 16rem). |

```html
<div class="lcars-grid" style="--lcars-grid-min: 18rem">
  <section class="lcars-bracket">…</section>
  <section class="lcars-bracket">…</section>
</div>
```

## Utilities

**Color:** `lcars-c-*` and `lcars-text-*` for every role and swatch (see Color model).

**Shape**

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-round` | Fully rounded (pill). |
| `lcars-round-start` | Rounded start (left) side only. |
| `lcars-round-end` | Rounded end (right) side only. |
| `lcars-square` | No rounding. |

**Flex sizing**

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-grow` | flex-grow: 1 — bar segment weight / sidebar filler. |
| `lcars-grow-0` | flex-grow: 0. |
| `lcars-grow-2` | flex-grow: 2. |
| `lcars-grow-3` | flex-grow: 3. |
| `lcars-grow-4` | flex-grow: 4. |
| `lcars-grow-6` | flex-grow: 6. |
| `lcars-grow-8` | flex-grow: 8. |

**Text**

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-upper` | Uppercase text. |
| `lcars-num` | Tabular numbers (and right-aligned inside .lcars-table). |
| `lcars-text-start` | text-align: start. |
| `lcars-text-center` | text-align: center. |
| `lcars-text-end` | text-align: end. |

**Motion**

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-pulse` | Brightness pulse (only without reduced motion). |
| `lcars-blink` | On/off blink (only without reduced motion). |

**Overflow**

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-scroll` | Horizontal scroll container for wide content such as tables; add tabindex="0" and an aria-label. |

**Accessibility**

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lcars-sr-only` | Visually hidden, still read by screen readers. |

## States

| Attribute / class | Applies to | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| aria-current (any value but "false") | .lcars-block, .lcars-button | Active color (--lcars-active). |
| aria-pressed="true" / aria-selected="true" / .is-active | .lcars-block, .lcars-button | Active color. |
| disabled / aria-disabled="true" | .lcars-block, .lcars-button, form controls | Dimmed, not-allowed cursor, no hover. |
| aria-invalid="true" | .lcars-input, .lcars-check, .lcars-switch | Alert color. |
| data-lcars-alert (on an ancestor) | frame elbows, bar segments, sidebar items | Pulse (set by LCARS.setAlert). |
| data-lcars-theme="id" | any element | Applies a theme to that subtree. |

## Themes

Set `data-lcars-theme="id"` on `<html>` or any element. No attribute = `tng`. Themes are fan interpretations of each series' look; some also change geometry.

| id | Series | Era | Character | Geometry overrides |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tng` | The Next Generation | 2364–2370 | Canonical LCARS; the default | — |
| `tos` | The Original Series | 2265–2269 | Pre-LCARS primaries, squarer corners | --lcars-inner-radius: 0.75rem; --lcars-elbow-rx: 40% |
| `snw` | Strange New Worlds | 2259– | Retro-modern gold, teal, red | — |
| `dis` | Discovery | 2256–3191 | Silver-blue, thin bars | --lcars-bar: 0.875rem; --lcars-gap: 0.375rem |
| `ent` | Enterprise | 2151–2155 | Gunmetal and amber, near-square corners | --lcars-inner-radius: 0.5rem; --lcars-elbow-rx: 25% |
| `ds9` | Deep Space Nine | 2369–2375 | Rust, tan, dusty lavender | — |
| `voy` | Voyager | 2371–2378 | Peach, gold, blue-lilac | — |
| `nemesis` | TNG films (First Contact–Nemesis) | 2373–2379 | Sovereign-class blues | — |
| `ld` | Lower Decks | 2380– | Bright, high contrast | — |
| `pro` | Prodigy | 2383– | Violet, teal, orange | — |
| `pic` | Picard | 2399–2401 | Slate blue, slimmer bars | --lcars-bar: 1rem; --lcars-inner-radius: 1rem |
| `red-alert` | Red alert | any | Condition red; use setAlert() (also remaps all swatches) | — |

Custom theme: copy any block from `src/css/themes.css` under a new id and define every role (`--lcars-bg`, `--lcars-fg`, `--lcars-primary`, `--lcars-secondary`, `--lcars-tertiary`, `--lcars-accent`, `--lcars-muted`, `--lcars-alert`, `--lcars-active`, `--lcars-heading`, `--lcars-link`).

## JavaScript (optional `lcars.js`)

Auto-initialises on load and upgrades elements added later. `<html data-lcars-manual>` disables auto-init.

**Attributes**

| Attribute | On | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-lcars-clock` | any element | Live 24h clock HH:MM:SS; value "hm" drops seconds. |
| `data-lcars-stardate` | any element | Today's stardate as YYYY.DDD. |
| `data-lcars-cascade="N"` | .lcars-data | Generates N random readouts and animates them. |
| `data-lcars-set-theme="id"` | clickable element | Switches the page theme on click ("" = default). |
| `data-lcars-theme-select` | <select> | Fills itself with every theme and switches on change. |
| `data-lcars-toggle-alert` | clickable element | Toggles red alert on click. |
| `data-lcars-sound="tap\|confirm\|deny\|alert\|red-alert\|ready"` | ancestor element | Clicks on interactive descendants play that sound (default tap; entering red alert plays red-alert); "off" disables. |
| `data-lcars-tone="…"` | interactive element | Overrides the sound for that element. |
| `role="button" inside .lcars-svg` | SVG shape | Enter / Space activate it like a button. |
| `aria-valuenow / -min / -max` | .lcars-meter | Kept in sync with --lcars-value. |
| `data-lcars-manual` | <html> | Disables auto-init; call LCARS.init(el) yourself. |

**API** (`import LCARS, { setTheme } from "lcars/lcars.js"` or `window.LCARS`)

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `init(scope = document)` | Upgrade LCARS elements inside scope. Idempotent. |
| `setTheme(id, el = <html>)` | Apply a theme id ("" or null = default). Fires "lcars:theme". |
| `setAlert(on?, el = <html>)` | Enter/leave red alert; no argument toggles. Restores the previous theme. Fires "lcars:alert". |
| `beep(tone = "tap", { volume })` | Play a console sound: tap (acknowledge), confirm (alternate acknowledge), deny (negative acknowledge), alert, red-alert or ready. Synthesized unless setSounds() gave it a file. |
| `setSounds({ tone: url \| null })` | Use your own audio files for any sound, e.g. setSounds({ "red-alert": "/sfx/klaxon.ogg" }); null restores the synthesized one. |
| `SOUNDS` | Array of the built-in sound names. |
| `stardate(date = new Date())` | "YYYY.DDD" string. |
| `clock(date = new Date(), { seconds = true })` | "HH:MM:SS" string. |
| `randomReadout(random = Math.random)` | Random LCARS-style number string. |
| `THEMES` | Array of { id, name, era, note } for every theme. |

**Events**

| Event | detail | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lcars:theme` | `{ theme: string \| null }` | Dispatched (bubbling) on the element whose theme changed. |
| `lcars:alert` | `{ active: boolean }` | Dispatched (bubbling) when red alert starts or ends. |

## Recipes

Full markup in docs/recipes.md; live pages in examples/recipes/.

| Recipe | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| `app-shell` | Full-page layout — header frame + body frame with sidebar navigation. Start every LCARS app from this. |
| `header-only` | A single header frame to put LCARS chrome above an existing (non-LCARS) app. Scope with class="lcars" on the header's wrapper if the rest of the page keeps its own styles. |
| `sidebar-nav` | Body frame whose sidebar holds the main navigation — current item marked with aria-current, a filler block, and an action pinned to the bottom. |
| `dashboard-tiles` | Grid of bracket cards showing KPIs with readouts and meters. Put this inside a frame's __main. |
| `section-heading` | A bar with a title used to divide a page into sections, followed by the section content. |
| `data-table` | Table with a heading bar, status pills, numeric columns and row actions. |
| `form` | Settings form in a bracket — text, select, textarea, switch, checkbox, range, a validation error and submit/cancel. |
| `tabs` | Segmented control / tabs built from small buttons with role="tab" and aria-selected; a few lines of JS switch panels. |
| `dialog` | Modal confirmation using a native <dialog class="lcars-dialog">; the frame inside gives it LCARS chrome. |
| `svg-control` | The classic circular X/Y control as inline SVG — shapes colored with .lcars-c-* classes, each quadrant and arrow a keyboard-accessible button. Geometry adapted from upstream's widget by jrwarwick (MIT). |
